properties.description: crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_revise_keeps_what_it_was_not_passed.rs. The membership is read off the SERVED tool list: every tool whose description says "optional to revise" (20 on 0.74.0). Each is created over the transport with every scalar property at a non-default value, TWICE with different values (a default equal to one synthesised value would hide a reset; it cannot equal both), revised by one field, and checked property by property and reply note by reply note against its create. A second case holds the REQUIRED-TO-CREATE half: an id-only create is refused or stores no empty placeholder. Counterweights: a first create still lands the documented defaults; a passed value still overwrites. A fourth pins add_verification refusing findings-without-status while naming the verdict the check already holds.
properties.findings: 2026-09-29, under the shared-target build protocol (clean rebuild of both workspace crates under one lock). FAILING FIRST on origin/main (329a074) plus the test alone: 9 breaches across 3 tools — record_finding fact_type (both passes) and basis (pass 0), plan_epoch description and checksum (both passes), add_change_event a false `undated` note (both passes) — and 7 tools (add_artifact, add_contributor, add_environment, add_flow, add_release, add_resource, add_verification) storing name: "" on an id-only create; the add_verification refusal named no verdict. After the fix, and again after merging main (cc3dbd0): 5/5 green, with the neighbouring mcp suites and reflow2-core --no-default-features green.
properties.name: A revise keeps what it was not passed, in every tool that promises it
